request.subject: UNIT:GOBLIN:FIGHTER

layers.text: Change his clothes and skin: the red bandana becomes a small orange-brown leather cap; take off the red tunic so his chest, belly, arms and legs are bare skin; he wears a short orange-brown leather loincloth and a harness of two crossed orange-brown leather straps on the chest. His skin a slightly deeper, darker true goblin green, not yellow. Keep the face, ears, dagger, belt, wrist bands, pose, proportions, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
